P6 (metric and counter-metrics): "Intent-caused" must be classified from git by a fixed rule written down before the trial, or it can be reclassified afterwards. The counter-metrics are evidence only, which is fine.
P7 (C5, C6, lens): The lens is a retro section and not a gate, so there is nothing to run red first. The missing and slow loops are candidates only, so I have no objection.
